name: bugfix
description: Reproduce a bug with a failing test and fix it in the same worker, review the fix blind, and fix only what a refuter or a probe confirms

steps.title: Reproduce and fix it
steps.prompt:
Fix this bug: {bug}

First write a test that fails because of it and show it failing for the reason described; then fix the cause, never by weakening that test, and run the whole suite before you stop.

steps.title: Review the fix
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file, the fix for: {bug}

Check from the diff named below that it fixes the cause rather than the symptom, that its test fails without it, and that it breaks nothing near it. Report each real problem in `findings`: its place (file:line), what is wrong, how it is known (`deterministic` with the command or hunk that shows it as `proof`, else `inferential`) and whether this change caused it. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Decide what the review only read
steps.prompt: Decide, without changing any file, the findings on the fix for: {bug}

steps.title: Fix the confirmed findings
steps.prompt:
Fix the confirmed findings below, in the fix for: {bug}

Run the tests before you stop.

steps.title: Check each fix
steps.prompt: Check, without changing any file, the fix just made in the fix for: {bug}
